items.name: Mandarin orange (clementine/tangerine), whole, unpeeled
items.preparation: raw, whole with peel on; edible mass excludes peel

scale_cues: White square plate (assumed ~25 cm side) filling most of the frame; the fruit spans roughly one fifth to one quarter of the plate width, giving a diameter of about 6 cm.
assumptions: Fruit is a mandarin/clementine rather than a small orange, based on its flattened shape, loose-looking skin and size.
Estimated whole weight is about 100 g; edible portion taken as ~75% after removing peel.
Reddish smears on the plate are residue from a previous food and carry negligible mass, so they are not logged.
Plate size assumed to be about 25 cm; no cutlery or hand visible for a firmer scale reference.
